patch_description: A fundamentally different approach: instead of a placeholder, we place the three triangle vertices plus 8 free points parametrized in barycentric coordinates (guaranteeing feasibility), then run a deterministic seeded simulated-annealing / iterative local search. The objective is the minimum normalized triangle area over all C(11,3)=165 triplets, computed fully vectorized with NumPy. A final greedy polish repeatedly moves points to improve the worst triangle. This directly optimizes the primary metric and is deterministic via fixed seeds.
